::: {#exr-gradient-noise}

#### How noisy is a minibatch gradient?

[lds's exercise on minibatches](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#exr-minibatch) shows that,
for minibatches drawn with replacement,
the minibatch gradient's variance is $1/b$ times that of one image's gradient, for batch size $b$.
For a fresh [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network) at its starting [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter),
estimate the mean squared distance between the minibatch gradient and the full-batch gradient,
over 200 minibatches each of sizes 8, 32 and 128.
Does $b$ times that mean squared distance stay about the same?

:::
